**Integration**
Name and version of the source integration (for example Huawei Solar 1.5.0).

**Hardware**
Inverter, battery, meter models.

**What works / what does not**
- [ ] Production
- [ ] Strings or micro-inverters
- [ ] Battery SoC / power
- [ ] Battery health (SoH, cycles)
- [ ] Grid import / export

**Diagnostics**
Attach the diagnostics file of Energy Hub.
